annotations.title: Passive 4-pillar TLS, OWASP HTTP header, DNS SPF/DMARC/CAA, and RFC

description: [0.005000 USDC via x402] Performs a 100% passive, non-intrusive security posture audit of any public domain across TLS 1.2/1.3 & X.509 hygiene (25 pts), OWASP HTTP headers (40 pts), DoH SPF/DMARC/CAA (30 pts), and RFC 9116 /.well-known/security.txt (5 pts), returning a 0-100 score, A+..F grade, and fixes.

domain.description: Public domain or hostname to audit passively (e.g., 'cloudflare.com').
